correctness.rationale: Exact standard-library polynomial-ring verification of the four-step trace, determinant, denominator, x0 and x2 coordinate numerators, and boundary trace; three independently computed exact-rational genuine attracting four-cycles. Universal necessity: Schur stability implies T>−1+uv³ while admissibility implies alpha<0, from which T<−1+uv³+2v(u−v), so u>v. Sufficiency: for each u>v the explicit boundary point r0=1+v, t0=(1+u)(1−v)/(1+v) is strictly Schur stable and t0>1−u; perturb both slopes positively to obtain strict x0<0<x1,x2,x3. The rational-coordinate formulas yield x0 linear and x2 quadratic in perturbation. No empirical-to-infinite extrapolation.

value.rationale: Complete, natural classification of existence of an attracting primitive LRRR four-cycle over a two-dimensional continuous invariant (the signed branch determinants): exactly one open triangular half of the unit determinant square supports such a cycle for some slopes, the other half never does. The explicit boundary construction yields a genuine quantitative two-order grazing phenomenon tied to that sharp threshold. This resolves a structural feature of the numerical four-cycle tongue in the primary paper, rather than making a routine isolated orbit computation.
